standard_prerequisites.name: The general descent lemma for flatness: flatness descends along a faithfully flat ring map
standard_prerequisites.use: Is the tool converting flatness upstairs into flatness downstairs in both parts.

standard_prerequisites.name: Flatness of the base change of a flat map, and flatness of a tensor product of flat modules
standard_prerequisites.use: Gives the flatness of the vertical arrows and the top horizontal arrow of the square.

standard_prerequisites.name: Weak etaleness as the conjunction of flatness of the map and flatness of the tensor square morphism
standard_prerequisites.use: Translates the two flatness statements into the weak etaleness conclusion.

core_obligations: Assume B -> C is faithfully flat and C tensor_A C -> C is flat, and consider the displayed commutative square with corners C tensor_A C, C, B tensor_A B and B (proof lines 30385-30393).
Note that the vertical arrows are flat and the top horizontal arrow is flat, and conclude that C is flat as a B tensor_A B-module (proof lines 30394-30395).
Since B -> C is faithfully flat and C = B tensor_B C, use the general descent lemma for flatness to conclude that B is flat as a B tensor_A B-module, which proves part (1) (proof lines 30395-30398).
Deduce part (2) from part (1) and the fact that A -> B is flat whenever A -> C is flat and B -> C is faithfully flat, by the same descent lemma (proof lines 30399-30401).
difficulty_reason: The lemma takes ring maps A -> B -> C and asserts two descents: that if B -> C is faithfully flat and C tensor_A C -> C is flat, then B tensor_A B -> B is flat; and that if B -> C is faithfully flat and A -> C is weakly etale, then A -> B is weakly etale (source lines 30374-30383). The proof of the first part is a descent along the displayed commutative square with corners C tensor_A C, C, B tensor_A B and B. The proof notes that the vertical arrows are flat and the top horizontal arrow is flat, whence C is flat as a B tensor_A B-module (proof lines 30385-30395). The substantive step is the descent: since B -> C is faithfully flat and C = B tensor_B C, the flatness of C over B tensor_A B descends to flatness of B over B tensor_A B, by the general descent lemma for flatness (proof lines 30395-30398). The second part then follows from the first together with the fact that A -> B is flat whenever A -> C is flat and B -> C is faithfully flat, again by the same descent lemma (proof lines 30399-30401). The non-routine content is the arrangement of the base-changed square so that the flatness of the top arrow plus faithful flatness of B -> C gives the conclusion by descent.
